author: L8580QEmarians

title: The Alhambra was very well explained!
text: We booked with Granada Turismo y Ocio and the experience was great, good prior communication to meet us at the shop in front of the entrance and above all a very professional and pleasant guide, Marian, who delighted us with many stories and details about the Alhambra. We left very happy, and also amazed by the place. The previous time we went without a guide and the expense is worth it for a service like this.
author: raulhF6168ZP

title: The guide was the best part of the visit
text: Great visit and the best part was Victoria the guide. We will return to Neri to do the night route and we will ask for Victoria to accompany us. Thank you for this day.
author: K3030PBjuanq

title: Nice enjoyable experience
text: The guided tour was excellent . She was knowledgeable, have a pleasing personality  and communicated well though sometime we could not understand few things because of the accent but she was kind enough to repeat them.

title: Entertaining visit to the Alhambra
text: Very interesting experience with Loris as a guide. She taught our group, was very attentive to everyone, and the group was not large.
author: K7715TIvictoriag

title: A great experience
text: We could not have had a better guide for the visit to the Alhambra. Vicky was very professional at all times, she explained the details with much affection and enthusiasm. Something that I liked a lot and that I would like to highlight, is that she is a person who cares for and takes care of the monument as if it were her own. Thank you very much Vicky!

title: An unforgettable experience

title: Impressive Alhambra
text: Impeccable organization. The guide, Vicky, was pleasant and competent. She made the experience, even with rain, something unforgettable.
